answer: An agent network can resist Sybil attacks via optical speckle attestation. Nodes probe a cleaved shale wafer masked with a raven carbon film, measuring laser backscatter from mineral micro-fractures to yield an unclonable hardware key. Adversaries seeking to harbor multiple identities incur the verifiable cost of provisioning discrete optical sensors and physical substrates per node. However, ambient thermal expansion distorts the speckle profile, causing false rejections.
